result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall, but one state inconsistency stands out: the 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected while the feed below is unfiltered (poké, burgers, ramen, pasta). No other visual breakage was found; the clipped carousel items and bottom card are expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is in the selected state (dark fill, white text), but the content below is not filtered to pizza: 'Fastest near you' shows Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccol…, and 'Popular right now' leads with Tokumaru Ramen Bar. The selected chip and the displayed content contradict each other.
issues.suggestion: Sync the chip's selected state with the feed: either filter the lists to pizza restaurants when 'Pizza' is active, or show 'All' as selected by default when the unfiltered home feed is displayed.
